cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
三天涨到 2,838 星
Rust 重写 skill 的校验法
cover.dek: rust-anything 创建第 3 天，日增 +2,262，11-17 日报时还只有 576 星。它把应用逐块重写成 Rust，每一步都对照原程序录下的行为做校验。
cover.title_en:
2,838 stars in three days:
the Rust rewrite skill that checks its work
cover.dek_en: rust-anything went from 576 stars in yesterday's report to 2,838, adding 2,262 in a day. It rewrites an app into Rust piece by piece and checks each step against behavior recorded from the original program.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: Context Has a Price 实测:在 prefix cache 折扣下,删旧观察可能不省钱,反而更贵。
stickers.text_en: Context Has a Price finds that dropping old observations can cost more once prefix cache discounts apply.

stickers.title: 新秀
stickers.text: Folio 用程序化折叠压缩上下文,在 LOCA-bench 解 66 题,模型写摘要的对照是 54 题。
stickers.text_en: Folio folds context with code, not model summaries. It solves 66 LOCA-bench tasks against 54 for the model-written baseline.

stickers.title: HN 热议
stickers.text: HN 头条讨论 AI 编码 Agent 把瓶颈挪到了代码评审,拿到 293 分、377 条评论。
stickers.text_en: The top HN thread says AI coding agents moved the bottleneck to code review: 293 points, 377 comments.
